text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 203-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 41.06 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
At an auction of 252-day T-bills on December 4 the yield was 32.25 percent.
Dealers forecast the average yield today would be between 35.12 and 40.27 percent.
The average yield of T-bill series 22057, which has the closest maturity to today's issue (series 22062), closed at 38.49 percent on Tuesday.
Full details of the auction follow:
Issue volume 8.50 trln rbls 8.50 trln rbls
Earlier the finance ministry raised 698.62 billion roubles by selling a new tranche of OFZ interest-bearing bonds (series 24009).
This takes proceeds from today's auctions to 7.39 trillion roubles.
The finance ministry has also paid 690.90 billion roubles in bond interest (series 24007) and repaid 6.47 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22036).
